trial_court: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nandyal, M.C. No. 13 of 2006
case_name: Nichenametla Vijaya Kumar vs Smt. Aruna Kumari And Another
facts_of_case: Petitioner and Respondent/wife were married in 2004. Disputes arose, leading to filing of divorce petition and maintenance claim. Trial court dismissed the maintenance claim. Petitioner filed this criminal revision case.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse who leaves the matrimonial home without just cause is not entitled to maintenance.
legal_principles.held: As seen from the record, the Respondent/wife herein filed M.C. No. 13 of 2006 and examined herself as PW1 and got marked Ex.P1 and Ex.P2.
cited_cases: Nichenametla Vijaya Kumar, vs Smt. Aruna Kumari And Another, (2020)

legal_principles.principle: A party who files a maintenance petition must establish that they are in need of support.
legal_principles.held: After considering the oral and documentary evidence on record, the Trial Court dismissed the M.C., which was set-aside in revision.
cited_cases: Nichenametla Vijaya Kumar, vs Smt. Aruna Kumari And Another, (2020)

outcome.final_order: The order under challenge requires interference.
